issues.title: [Epic] Automated Quality Foundation
acceptance_criteria: Node 18 and 20 checks run on every pull request.
Unit and smoke tests have repeatable fixtures and regression coverage.
Lifecycle and configuration regressions fail locally and in CI.

issues.title: [Epic] Agent Lifecycle Reliability
acceptance_criteria: Repeated failures cannot create unbounded restart loops.
Agent shutdown removes registered timers and listeners.
Operators receive redacted diagnostics for lifecycle failures.

issues.title: [Epic] Configuration and Startup Experience
acceptance_criteria: Invalid configuration fails before agents spawn.
A doctor command reports readiness without starting Minecraft.
Dashboard and documentation expose the same startup diagnosis.

issues.title: [Epic] Installable and Reproducible Releases
acceptance_criteria: Supported Node and package contracts are machine-checkable.
CLI and Docker startup paths pass the same smoke contract.
Release candidates are validated from a clean installation.

issues.title: [Story] Add CI lint and Node 18/20 matrix
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions runs `npx eslint .` on Node 18 and Node 20.
The workflow runs on pull requests and pushes to `develop`.
A failing lint result blocks the workflow.

issues.title: [Story] Introduce unit-test framework and shared fixtures
acceptance_criteria: A documented `npm test` command runs locally without Minecraft or external API keys.
Shared fixtures cover settings, profiles, child-process events, and mocked agent state.
At least one representative test demonstrates fixture use.

issues.title: [Story] Build deterministic task smoke-test harness
acceptance_criteria: A smoke command validates task parsing and launch preparation without contacting a live Minecraft server.
The harness returns non-zero on malformed task fixtures.
CI runs at least one valid and one invalid fixture.

issues.title: [Story] Add lifecycle and configuration regression tests
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover child-process exit classification and restart eligibility.
Tests cover invalid settings, missing profiles, and malformed task input.
Regression cases run in the standard test command.

issues.title: [Story] Define structured lifecycle states and errors
acceptance_criteria: Agent lifecycle states and transitions use one documented contract.
Process exits and connection failures map to stable error codes.
Existing consumers retain human-readable messages.

issues.title: [Story] Add bounded restart policy with backoff
acceptance_criteria: Restart attempts use a documented maximum and increasing delay.
Stable runtime resets the retry budget.
Exhaustion leaves the agent stopped with an actionable terminal state.

issues.title: [Story] Guarantee listener, timer, and action cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Agent shutdown clears owned timers, socket listeners, and pending actions.
Repeated start and stop cycles do not increase listener counts.
Cleanup is idempotent and covered by regression tests.

issues.title: [Story] Produce redacted diagnostic bundles
acceptance_criteria: A diagnostic command captures versions, lifecycle state, errors, and configuration shape.
API keys, tokens, chat content, and full prompts are excluded.
The bundle is suitable for attachment to a GitHub issue.

issues.title: [Story] Add schema-based configuration validation
acceptance_criteria: Settings, profiles, and environment overrides validate before agents spawn.
Errors identify the field, received value class, and expected constraint.
Valid existing example profiles continue to load.

issues.title: [Story] Add npm run doctor environment checks
acceptance_criteria: `npm run doctor` checks runtime, dependencies, profiles, paths, and ports.
The command does not start agents or require Minecraft.
Output includes pass, warning, and failure statuses with remediation.

issues.title: [Story] Surface startup diagnostics in the dashboard
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays preflight, startup, and terminal failure states.
Operators can distinguish major startup failure categories.
Displayed diagnostics remain redacted.

issues.title: [Story] Rewrite setup and troubleshooting guidance
acceptance_criteria: README and FAQ follow supported local and Docker paths.
Troubleshooting maps symptoms to doctor and dashboard diagnostics.
Examples use supported Node versions and contain no credentials.

issues.title: [Story] Define supported Node and package contract
acceptance_criteria: `package.json` declares supported Node versions and package metadata.
The lockfile and installation policy are documented.
Unsupported runtimes fail with a clear preflight message.

issues.title: [Story] Add packaged CLI and startup entrypoint
acceptance_criteria: An installed command can run doctor, start Mindcraft, and select profiles or tasks.
CLI arguments preserve current `main.js` behavior.
Exit codes distinguish usage, validation, and runtime failures.

issues.title: [Story] Add Docker health checks and local parity validation
acceptance_criteria: The container exposes a MindServer readiness health check.
Docker and local startup use the same configuration validation.
A documented smoke command verifies startup and clean shutdown.

issues.title: [Story] Add release installation smoke matrix
acceptance_criteria: CI installs the release artifact in clean Node 18 and Node 20 environments.
The matrix runs doctor plus CLI and Docker smoke checks where supported.
Validation fails on missing files or startup-contract regressions.
